item.title: [Latent Space] Controlling Biology - Fabian Theis, Helmholtz Munich
item.description:
We can really now start guiding the experimentation. So where before you, we built these human cell atlases, we had sort of this mapping aspect. Then we talked about the world models prediction problem.
From mapping, we went to prediction. But now we can go to actually steering the next experiment. But quite frankly, very often the papers ended with some model, right?
Maybe some sort of concept figure, maybe add a little bit validation. But then typically you start the next project, right? And...
